decision.exact_command_or_message: Agent description: '[case:investigate] imm26-fixfail: root cause for every FAIL row in testing/NPC_IMMERSION_26_TESTS.md with no fix commit newer than its last FAIL run'. Name: imm26-fixfail. Brief: list those FAIL rows with their latest RESULT line and excerpt= file; for each, find the function under test with grep -n and read it by sed line ranges (never whole large files); write the root cause and the smallest anchor-checked patch proposal to C:\KenshiModding\pending-fixes\npc-immersion-26\ (no whole-file copies, no weakened assertions). Do not edit any script a queued or running row list uses. Update the status with agent-status.ps1 imm26-fixfail RUNNING|DONE|FAILED after every row and at least every 8 minutes. Report one line per row: row id, root cause, patch path, ready to re-queue yes/no. Patches are applied afterwards by a [case:patch] generator, not by this agent.
decision.why: Shay asked whether every failure is fixed and the rows show open FAILs with no fix; the routing rule sends a bug to [case:investigate] first, so diagnosis runs now in parallel while the patch step waits for its report.

decision.exact_command_or_message: Wait for: the imm26-fixfail report; the travel investigator reply (C:\KenshiTestRuns\agents\out\imm26-travel-blocker, or the imm26-travel-investigate2 result); the patch notices in C:\KenshiTestRuns\agents\imm26-wpA4.status and imm26-wpB4.status; and the imm26-5090-ctxop32 RESULT lines. Never mark a row PASS without a RESULT line from a real run.
decision.why: Re-queueing is the closing step once a fix is in place, and HANDOFF and the ledger must record it at once so a new coordinator sees the state.
